mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODUCT_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.PRICE, A.CATEGORY_GROUP, A.CATEGORY_MID, A.CATEGORY_SCLS, A.SALE_STATUS, A.REGISTER_NO, A.REGIST_DT, A.UPDUSR_NO, A.UPDT_DT, (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID= A.PRODUCT_ID AND REPRESENT=1) AS IMAGE_URL, (SELECT USER_ID FROM op_user WHERE USER_NO= A.USER_NO ) AS USER_ID FROM tb_product A WHERE A.SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product ( USER_NO, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, CATEGORY_GROUP, CATEGORY_MID, CATEGORY_SCLS, SALE_STATUS, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, -- 사용자 번호 (VO: userNo) #{title}, -- 제목 (VO: title) #{description}, -- 설명 (VO: description) #{price}, -- 가격 (VO: price) #{categoryGroup}, -- 대분류 (VO: categoryGroup) #{categoryMid}, -- 중분류 (VO: categoryMid) #{categoryScls}, -- 소분류 (VO: categoryScls) #{saleStatus}, -- 판매 상태 (VO: saleStatus) #{registerNo}, -- 등록자 번호 (VO: registerNo) CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, -- 등록일자 (VO: registDt) #{updusrNo}, -- 수정자 번호 (VO: updusrNo) CURRENT_TIMESTAMP -- 수정일자 (VO: updtDt) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, PRICE = #{price}, CATEGORY_GROUP = #{categoryGroup}, CATEGORY_MID = #{categoryMid}, CATEGORY_SCLS = #{categoryScls}, SALE_STATUS = #{saleStatus}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID, PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_CD, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_NAME, REPRESENT, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TEXT, IMAGE_TYPE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT FROM tb_product_image WHERE IMAGE_ID = #{imageId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product_image ( PRODUCT_ID, IMAGE_CD, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_NAME, REPRESENT, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TEXT, IMAGE_TYPE, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{imageCd}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageName}, #{represent}, #{imageSize}, #{imageText}, #{imageType}, #{registerNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updusrNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product_image SET IMAGE_CD = #{imageCd}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl}, IMAGE_NAME = #{imageName}, REPRESENT = #{represent}, IMAGE_SIZE = #{imageSize}, IMAGE_TEXT = #{imageText}, IMAGE_TYPE = #{imageType}, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE IMAGE_ID = #{imageId}
mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, USER_NO, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, CATEGORY_GROUP, CATEGORY_MID, CATEGORY_SCLS, SALE_STATUS, REGISTER_NO, REGIST_DT, UPDUSR_NO, UPDT_DT FROM tb_product WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
